mapper.select: SELECT b.module_code AS moduleCode, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.definition_json, '$.protocolVersion')) AS protocolVersion, m.model_code AS defaultModelCode FROM aid_runtime_module_agent_binding b JOIN aid_runtime_agent a ON a.id = b.runtime_agent_id JOIN aid_runtime_agent_version v ON v.id = b.active_version_id AND v.agent_id = a.id JOIN aid_ai_model m ON m.model_code = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.model_config_json, '$.defaultModelCode')) AND m.status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' JOIN aid_ai_provider p ON p.id = m.provider_id AND p.status = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.del_flag = '0' AND a.agent_family = 'ASSISTANT_LOOP' AND a.status = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.current_version_id = v.id AND v.status = '0' AND v.del_flag = '0' AND v.publish_status = 'FROZEN' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_runtime_module_agent_binding other WHERE other.runtime_agent_id = a.id AND other.module_code != b.module_code AND other.status = 'ACTIVE' AND other.del_flag = '0') ORDER BY b.module_code LIMIT 20

SELECT v.id FROM aid_runtime_module_agent_binding b JOIN aid_runtime_agent a ON a.id = b.runtime_agent_id JOIN aid_runtime_agent_version v ON v.id = b.active_version_id AND v.agent_id = a.id WHERE b.module_code = #{moduleCode} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.del_flag = '0' AND a.agent_family = 'ASSISTANT_LOOP' AND a.status = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.current_version_id = v.id AND v.status = '0' AND v.del_flag = '0' AND v.publish_status = 'FROZEN' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aid_runtime_module_agent_binding other WHERE other.runtime_agent_id = a.id AND other.module_code != b.module_code AND other.status = 'ACTIVE' AND other.del_flag = '0') LIMIT 2
